title: Course & Amenities – Bank of America Chicago Marathon
claims: The course starts and finishes in Grant Park and runs through 29 neighbourhoods; the organiser describes it as flat and fast, notes it has produced seven world records, and puts spectator support at 1.7 million.

There are 20 aid stations approximately one to two miles apart; each has a medical tent with runner transport, standard and ADA portable toilets, Gatorade Endurance Formula (lemon-lime), a public-address announcer and water; medical support covers 22 on-course locations.
Timing checkpoints are at the start, each 5K, the halfway point at 13.1 miles, miles 20–25, mile 25.2 and the finish; digital clocks sit at the start, every five kilometres and the finish.

The course time limit is 6:30, a 15-minute-per-mile pace; an event vehicle following the last starter sets the pace for reopening the course; participants finishing after 4 p.m. may not be recorded or published as official finishers.
The event is recognised as a World Athletics Platinum Label road race.
